get_webhook_variable.title: Get Variable Elements
get_webhook_variable.description: This endpoint allows you to read the values within a Custom Webhook variable. It supports pagination with `limit` and `after` (and optionally `pageKey`) query parameters.

variable.description: String denoting a Custom Webhook variable

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

after.description: The cursor that points to the end of the current set of results.

page_key.description: Page cursor for the next page.

output.description: OK- Successful query of Custom Webhook variable

create_webhook_variable.title: Create a Variable
create_webhook_variable.description: This endpoint allows you to create a variable that can be inserted into a Custom Webhook GraphQL statement. If the variable does not exist, it is created with the provided items. If it already exists, the call is additive: existing items are unchanged, new items are appended, and duplicates are ignored (no error is thrown).

variable.description: String denoting a Custom Webhook variable

items.description: A variable defined as a set of addresses or byte32 elements. Must be non-empty.

output.description: OK- Successful creation of a Custom Webhook variable

update_webhook_variable.title: Update a Variable
update_webhook_variable.description: Add and remove elements within a Custom Webhook variable The use of both `add` and `delete` arrays within a single request is currently not supported. Attempting to send both will result in a 400 error. To add and remove elements, make separate API calls for each action.

variable.description: String denoting a Custom Webhook variable

add.description: Set of elements to be added to a Custom Webhook variable

delete.description: Set of elements to be deleted from a Custom Webhook variable

output.description: OK- Successful update to Custom Webhook variable

delete_webhook_variable.title: Delete a Variable
delete_webhook_variable.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a Custom Webhook variable. This cannot be undone.

variable.description: String denoting a Custom Webhook variable

output.description: OK- Successful deletion of a Custom Webhook variable

list_webhooks.title: Get all webhooks
list_webhooks.description: Get all webhooks. This endpoint allows you to get all webhooks on your team.

list_webhook_addresses.title: Get all addresses for an Address Activity webhook
list_webhook_addresses.description: Paginated endpoint to list all of the addresses a given Address Activity webhook is subscribed to.

webhook_id.description: ID of the address activity webhook.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

after.description: The cursor that points to the end of the current set of results.

page_key.description: Page cursor for the next page.

output.description: List of addresses and pagination info.

data.description: List of addresses associated with the webhook.

create_webhook.title: Create webhook
create_webhook.description: Create webhook. This endpoint allows you to create a webhook. Requires network, webhook_type, webhook_url. Optional: name, graphql_query, addresses, nft_filters.

graphql_query.description: For GRAPHQL (custom) webhooks: the GraphQL query that selects the on-chain data to deliver, as a string or {query, skip_empty_messages}.

addresses.description: List of addresses to track. Required for ADDRESS_ACTIVITY webhook type.

nft_filters.description: List of NFT filter objects to track. Required for NFT_ACTIVITY webhook type. Each item is an object. Fields: contract_address, token_id.

data.description: Fields: id, network, webhook_type, webhook_url, is_active, time_created, version, signing_key.

replace_webhook_addresses.title: Replace webhook addresses
replace_webhook_addresses.description: Replace entire list of addresses tracked in a given webhook. Requires webhook_id, addresses.

webhook_id.description: ID of the address activity webhook.

addresses.description: New list of addresses to track (replaces any existing addresses).

update_webhook_addresses.title: Add and remove webhook addresses
update_webhook_addresses.description: Add or remove addresses from a specific webhook. This webhook endpoint is idempotent, meaning that identical requests can be made once or several times with the same effect.

webhook_id.description: ID of the address activity webhook

addresses_to_add.description: List of addresses to add (empty array if none).

addresses_to_remove.description: List of addresses to remove (empty array if none).

update_webhook.title: Update webhook
update_webhook.description: Update webhook properties such as name or status. Requires webhook_id. Optional: is_active, name.

is_active.description: Set webhook status (true for active, false for inactive)

data.description: Fields: id, network, webhook_type, webhook_url, is_active, time_created, version, signing_key.

update_webhook_nft_filters.title: Update webhook NFT filters
update_webhook_nft_filters.description: Update webhook NFT filters. Add and remove webhook NFT filters. Requires webhook_id. Optional: nft_filters_to_add, nft_filters_to_remove.

webhook_id.description: ID of the address activity webhook

nft_filters_to_add.description: List of NFT filters to add (empty array if none). Each item is an object. Fields: contract_address, token_id.

nft_filters_to_remove.description: List of NFT filters to remove (empty array if none). Each item is an object. Fields: contract_address, token_id.

list_webhook_nft_filters.title: Get all webhook NFT filters
list_webhook_nft_filters.description: Paginated endpoint to list all of the NFT filter objects a given webhook is subscribed to.

webhook_id.description: ID of the address activity webhook.

limit.description: The maximum number of items to return per page.

after.description: The cursor that points to the end of the current set of results.

page_key.description: Page cursor for the next page.

output.description: Returns a list of nft filter objects.

delete_webhook.title: Delete webhook
delete_webhook.description: Delete webhook. Allows you to delete a webhook. This cannot be undone.

webhook_id.description: ID of the address activity webhook.
